# Our own XSS vectors. Each record starts with "# name"; records are separated by lines of "====".
# {HOST} stands for the host of a request-logging server. Script vectors call alert(1), which the test page counts.
# Written from the categories in public evasion lists (the OWASP XSS Filter Evasion Cheat Sheet, the HTML5 Security Cheatsheet,
# published mutation-XSS research); no text is copied from them.
# script-plain
<script>alert(1)</script>
====
# script-src-remote
<script src="http://{HOST}/p/script.js"></script>
====
# script-case-mixed
<ScRiPt>alert(1)</sCrIpT>
====
# script-nested-split
<scr<script>ipt>alert(1)</scr</script>ipt>
====
# script-in-tag-lookalike
<b <script>alert(1)//</script>0</script></b>
====
# script-unclosed
<script>alert(1)
====

<bgsound src="http://{HOST}/p/bgsound">
====
# remote-body-background
<body background="http://{HOST}/p/body-background-attr">x</body>
====
# remote-body-style-background
<body style="background-image:url(http://{HOST}/p/body-style)">x</body>
====
# remote-svg-image
<svg width=10 height=10><image xlink:href="http://{HOST}/p/svg-xlink"/></svg>
====
# remote-img-lowsrc
<img lowsrc="http://{HOST}/p/lowsrc" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACw=">
====
# remote-img-dynsrc
<img dynsrc="http://{HOST}/p/dynsrc">
====
# remote-input-src
<input src="http://{HOST}/p/input-src" type=image>
====
# remote-object-codebase
<object codebase="http://{HOST}/p/codebase" classid="clsid:x"></object>
====
# remote-table-background-nested
<table><tr><td><table background="http://{HOST}/p/nested-table">x</table></td></tr></table>
====
# remote-style-escape-url
<div style="background:\75rl(http://{HOST}/p/escaped-url)">x</div>
====
# remote-style-url-uppercase
<div style="background:URL(http://{HOST}/p/upper)">x</div>
====
# remote-style-url-spaces
<div style="background: url( 'http://{HOST}/p/spaces' )">x</div>
====
# remote-style-entities
<div style="background:url(&quot;http://{HOST}/p/entity&quot;)">x</div>
====
# remote-style-protocol-relative
<div style="background:url(//{HOST}/p/css-protocol-relative)">x</div>
====
# remote-style-multiple
<div style="background:url(http://{HOST}/p/m1),url(http://{HOST}/p/m2)">x</div>
====
# remote-style-gradient-fallback
<div style="background:url(http://{HOST}/p/grad), linear-gradient(red, blue)">x</div>
====
# remote-style-bad-url
<div style="background:url(http://{HOST}/p/bad url with space)">x</div>
